public class Codeforces {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String line = reader.readLine();
        reader.close();

        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int answer = n;

            if (computeChance(n, i) >= p) {
                answer = i;
                break;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(answer);
    }

    static int choose(int total, int pick) {
        if (pick < 0 || pick > total) return 0;
        if (pick == 0 || pick == total) return 1;
        pick = Math.min(pick, total - pick);
        long result = 1;
        for (int j = 1; j <= pick; j++) {
            result = result * (total - pick + j) / j;
        }
        return (int) result;
    }

    static double computeChance(int n, int x) {
        long numerator = choose(x, 3) * choose(n - x, 0);
        numerator += choose(x, 2) * choose(n - x, 1);
        numerator += (long) (0.5 * choose(x, 1) * choose(n - x, 2));
        long denominator = choose(n, 3);
        return (double) numerator / denominator;
    }
}
